title: FacetManager
description: Manages facet ordering and cross-facet concerns. Holds the backend-determined order of facet components as state. The position of each identifier (indexed from 0) determines the facet's rendering rank. Ready to gain cross-facet actions (e.g., clear all facets, reorder) as needs arise.

FacetManagerState.title: FacetManagerState
FacetManagerState.description: The facet manager state. Facet ordering is expressed via the facet-manager A2-UI component node's 'children'; this state carries no facet-ordering data.
